name: Keqing
title: Driving Thunder
description: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing has much to say about Rex Lapis's unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue — but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.

skills.name: Yunlai Swordsmanship
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Stellar Restoration
skills.description:
Hurls a Lightning Stiletto that annihilates her opponents like the swift thunder.
When the Stiletto hits its target, it deals Electro DMG to opponents in a small AoE, and places a Stiletto Mark on the spot hit.

Hold
Hold to adjust the direction in which the Stiletto shall be thrown.
Stilettos thrown by the Hold attack mode can be suspended in mid-air, allowing Keqing to jump to them when using Stellar Restoration a second time.

Lightning Stiletto
If Keqing uses Stellar Restoration again or uses a Charged Attack while its duration lasts, it will clear the Stiletto Mark and produce different effects:
·If she uses Stellar Restoration again, she will blink to the location of the Mark and unleash one slashing attack that deals AoE Electro DMG. When blinking to a Stiletto that was thrown from a Holding attack, Keqing can leap across obstructing terrain.
·If Keqing uses a Charged Attack, she will ignite a series of thundering cuts at the Mark's location, dealing AoE Electro DMG.
skills.info: "Humans are like moths, endlessly chasing the flame we call gods and adepti. But this light that I have here is my own."

skills.name: Starward Sword
skills.description:
Keqing unleashes the power of lightning, dealing Electro DMG in an AOE.
She then blends into the shadow of her blade, striking a series of thunderclap-blows to nearby opponents simultaneously that deal multiple instances of Electro DMG. The final attack deals massive AoE Electro DMG.
skills.info: The swiftest technique in Keqing's personal arsenal is fast enough to bring stars crashing down.

passives.name: Thundering Penance
passives.description: After recasting Stellar Restoration while a Lightning Stiletto is present, Keqing's weapon gains an Electro Infusion for 5s.

passives.name: Aristocratic Dignity
passives.description: When casting Starward Sword, Keqing's CRIT Rate is increased by 15%, and her Energy Recharge is increased by 15%. This effect lasts for 8s.

passives.name: Land's Overseer
passives.description: When dispatched on an expedition in Liyue, time consumed is reduced by 25%.

constellations.name: Thundering Might
constellations.description: Recasting Stellar Restoration while a Lightning Stiletto is present causes Keqing to deal 50% of her ATK as AoE Electro DMG at the start point and terminus of her Blink.

constellations.name: Keen Extraction
constellations.description:
When Keqing's Normal and Charged Attacks hit opponents affected by Electro, they have a 50% chance of producing an Elemental Particle.
This effect can only occur once every 5s.

constellations.name: Foreseen Reformation
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Starward Sword by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Attunement
constellations.description: For 10s after Keqing triggers an Electro-related Elemental Reaction, her ATK is increased by 25%.

constellations.name: Beckoning Stars
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Stellar Restoration by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Tenacious Star
constellations.description:
When initiating a Normal Attack, a Charged Attack, Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, Keqing gains a 6% Electro DMG Bonus for 8s.
Effects triggered by Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts are considered independent entities.

outfits.name: Opulent Splendor
outfits.description: Keqing's formal wear. Amidst the beautiful dawn of the Lantern Rite, the threads weaved by days of hard work intertwine into a light yet magnificent appearance.

outfits.name: Piercing Thunderbolt
outfits.description: Keqing's outfit. A formidable-looking dress made using luxurious materials.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: I am Keqing, Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. We live in an era of change, as the old order that has existed for a thousand years is about to be rewritten. Join me. Let us bear witness to this historical moment together.

voices.title: Chat: Delays
voices.text: Come on. Enough procrastinating. Let's go.

voices.title: Chat: Relax
voices.text: I'm all for work-life balance, but I think this is pushing it.

voices.title: Chat: Opportunity
voices.text: In adventuring, as in business, you always have to seize the opportunity while it's there.

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: Quite a downpour... Nothing will get done until it clears. Let this be a lesson to those who yesterday said, "I'll do it tomorrow."

voices.title: When Thunder Strikes
voices.text: Thunder and lightning can be quite frightening, but don't worry — Liyue's storm and fire defenses are second to none.

voices.title: When It Snows
voices.text: Don't worry, snowfall on this scale is no impediment. We can keep moving.

voices.title: When the Sun Is Out
voices.text: Ah, the sun is out. Our work's done for the day... shall we take a stroll?

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: Morning. Time to set the tone for the rest of the day, so if you're still feeling sleepy, shake it off!

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: I'm not in the habit of napping at noon, but don't let that stop you if you're feeling tired. I'll give you a wake-up call in, say, three minutes' time.

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: The lights are coming on now that the night is setting in. *yawn* Another delightful day draws to a close.

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: Sleep well. ...Me? Uh... I still have a handful of things on my to-do list, but I'll call it a night once they're done.

voices.title: About Keqing: Idealism
voices.text: If you feel strongly about something, you should speak up and take action. That's the philosophy I live by.

voices.title: About Keqing: Work
voices.text: My role is to manage real estate and construction in Liyue. Sure, Liyue is a vast place with abundant resources — but without proper planning, and if too much focus is placed on short-term profit, a great many things can go wrong.

voices.title: About Keqing: Skepticism
voices.text: What do you think has kept Liyue going over the last millennium? Rex Lapis? ...I disagree. We mortals have to fight for survival whatever happens. He just feels the need to come down here and poke his nose into everything that's going on for some reason... Hmph, people don't like to think about this, but should we really be trusting him to be an expert in everything?

voices.title: About Keqing: Self-Reflection
voices.text: After I took on the management of so many of Liyue's affairs, I had a new-found respect for Rex Lapis and all his hard work over the last millennium. Recently, every time I come up against a difficult problem with no obvious solution, I find myself thinking: What would Rex Lapis do? Maybe he really IS an expert in everything, and I've got more left to learn than I realized...

voices.title: About Us: Pursuing
voices.text: You know why I like you? It's because you don't believe something just because it was said by a god. You make up your own mind. You ask the questions everyone else is too cowardly to ask, and when you don't get an answer, you keep looking till you find one. Oh don't worry — your way is definitely the right way. Who says gods don't make mistakes, anyway?

voices.title: About Us: Trying
voices.text: It's not difficult, you'll see. Just give it a try. What if you try and it doesn't work out? ...No, I don't believe that will happen. You've never let me down before. You don't seem the type.

voices.title: About Us: Encouragement
voices.text: I used to be so naive. I genuinely believed I was on par with Rex Lapis... Seems I really overestimated myself. Hmm? Yes... You're right! I have plenty of self-confidence in other areas, so why not in this? ...I can catch up with him — I WILL catch up with him! I just need to keep my chin up, keep trying, and keep learning!

voices.title: About the Vision: Skepticism
voices.text: If a Vision means the approval of the gods, then I don't see why I should want one. In fact, I find it quite insulting... It's like trying to say everything I've ever achieved is all thanks to the gods looking out for me! Well, I got to where I am today through my own hard work. The gods had nothing to do with it.

voices.title: About the Vision: Reflection
voices.text: Oh, so... Rex Lapis wanted me to have power beyond the average mortal so that I can be a great leader? Huh... I like to think I'd do an admirable job even without his blessing! Yeah, I'll show him... I won't give him any reason to be disappointed with me...

voices.title: Something to Share: Initiative
voices.text: In addition to my work with the Liyue Qixing, I do a lot of work for the public, too. Mostly the feedback is positive, but whenever I propose something like adding an extra hour to the workday, I come up against very strong resistance... I'm too forward-thinking, I suppose. Maybe I should start with a half hour instead?

voices.title: Something to Share: Souvenir
voices.text: What do you mean, Geo Archon paraphernalia? ...You're not suggesting my bedroom is full of that stuff, surely? I'm not a child anymore! Although... Okay, I did buy a couple of Rex Lapis figurines recently, but — but, they're just to keep me on the straight and narrow. Look, just because I own an idol or two does not mean that I idolize him, okay!?

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: I once heard a Mondstadt fable about courage being what it takes for birds to learn to fly. But I think that you must first possess a yearning for the boundless skies before you would have any inclination, let alone the courage, to spread your wings and try to fly. For me, Liyue is that boundless sky.

voices.title: About Zhongli
voices.text: The gentleman from the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor? Clearly, he's an extremely learned individual, and I do have a lot of respect for him. But his mindset is too traditional for me — he thinks in the same tired old terms as Rex Lapis did... If he were more of an original thinker, I'm sure he'd be a great asset to me in reaching my objectives.

voices.title: About Beidou
voices.text: That captain is always flouting the rules, and her personality really rubs people the wrong way. That said, The Crux Fleet is indispensable to Liyue Harbor. It's a bit of an art, knowing when to enforce the rules and when it's in everyone's interests to be more lenient. Thing is, the Tianquan is supposed to be the one enforcing the rules, but she always seems to be too busy...

voices.title: About Ningguang: Conflict
voices.text: We do work together, but we couldn't be more opposite personality-wise. To her, Liyue Harbor is nothing more than a marketplace, and she'll do anything as long as it makes money for her. Doesn't she have any principles? Hmm, or maybe turning a profit IS her principle?

voices.title: About Ningguang: Cooperation
voices.text: Since Rex Lapis left us, we've actually found some common ground. I was quite judgmental of her in the past, and we still fundamentally disagree on a number of issues, but in the current climate I have to say I count her as a comrade in arms.

voices.title: About Ningguang: Trifling Matters
voices.text: Ugh, having said that... I ordered a Lucent Crescent from Mingxing Jewelry three months in advance, and when it was finally time to pick it up, they told me Ningguang had bought up the last few months' worth of Lucent Crescents for herself by paying double the price! *sigh* She can be such a pain!

voices.title: About Xinyan
voices.text: You know what, I think her music rocks. Too noisy by traditional standards, for sure, but I don't care. Good music is good music. And good music should reach the widest possible audience.

voices.title: About Baizhu
voices.text: Everyone has faith in Dr. Baizhu's medical skills. He's the right guy to go to when you can't figure out what's wrong with you. Oh... the rumors, you say? The only one that I know for a fact is true is how disgusting his medicine tastes. It's not just the kids who find it bitter, it's left me with some horrible memories, too!

voices.title: About Xiangling
voices.text: Yeah, the up-and-coming chef from Wanmin Restaurant... I get that she's gifted and everything, I just think her cooking can be a bit hit-or-miss. I was all ready to hire her for a small banquet once, and give her full control over the menu... but the amount of lizard and slime in her sample dishes quickly turned me off that idea!

voices.title: About Xingqiu
voices.text: I've heard his story — he was born into a well-to-do family, but wasn't keen on the family business, so he now devotes his time to being an envoy of justice. I have huge respect for that! Not everyone has the guts to follow their dreams when it means breaking with a long-standing family tradition.

voices.title: About Xiao
voices.text: I feel like now that we live in the age of mankind's rule, it's time for the legendary boy-adeptus to be released from duty. We no longer need a defender of that kind, because we are capable of working through the challenges we face on our own strength.

voices.title: About Ganyu: Skepticism
voices.text: Who knows what Rex Lapis must have done to inspire such blind devotion from Ganyu... But her reluctance to be critical is not without its advantages. In the workplace, she'll carry out my instructions to the letter, even when I can tell she has her reservations. It's a good attitude to have as a career professional.

voices.title: About Ganyu: Reflection
voices.text: I find myself getting a second opinion from her a lot these days. Lots of things come up that I just have no idea about, and of everyone in Liyue, she's probably the most familiar with Rex Lapis. Heh... I feel a bit awkward, though, because I used to be openly disparaging of Rex Lapis in front of her... But she doesn't seem to mind, so I guess I've got nothing to worry about...

voices.title: About Yun Jin
voices.text: When you're passing by Heyu Tea House and have to squeeze your way through the biggest crowd you've seen in your life, that's when you know Yun Jin's on stage performing. There's not a merchant in Liyue who wouldn't buy up the place if they had the chance, and Yun Jin is the reason it would be worth every Mora.

voices.title: About the Anemo Archon
voices.text: Since Rex Lapis left us, the question of Liyue's future has been on my mind constantly. In addition to reviewing his own past deeds, I've been researching the other archons' modes of governance, too. Mondstadt's god is the one who baffles me the most though — how exactly do any of his actions contribute to the longevity of Mondstadt? It's completely beyond me.

voices.title: About Yanfei
voices.text: The way I see it, the law is a summary of things done the right way in the past. However, it should also be continuously adapted and improved to match the needs of the present. Given that Liyue is about to undergo a radical transformation, legal talent is in great demand. With an assistant like Yanfei, I could spare myself a great deal of trouble.

voices.title: About Yelan
voices.text: Ms. Yelan's ancestors used to serve the Qixing. My grandfather and her family have had academic collaborations in the past. All in all, she's reliable, efficient, and provides important intel to the Ministry of Civil Affairs. I can't say for sure how Ms. Yelan actually gets her intel, however...

voices.title: About Lan Yan
voices.text: Madame Lan is a lovely young lady and a very talented craftswoman. As the Ministry of Civil Affairs works to promote local craftmanship in the future, we will certainly consult masters like her. Oh, what about outside of work? Of course, she's welcome in Liyue Harbor any time. I find her company very enjoyable.

voices.title: More About Keqing: I
voices.text: You want to know more about me? Sure. Let's start with the principles that are central to the role of Yuheng. Once you've memorized the hundred or more contractual obligations of the position, you'll know my hopes and dreams like the back of your hand!

voices.title: More About Keqing: II
voices.text: Nothing exists independently, and there's nothing you can do to change that. So, when you drag your heels on one thing, you're actually causing chaos for a whole bunch of other connected issues, too. That's why I firmly believe you should never put off until tomorrow what you can do today. ...I'm also a very impatient person and can't stand procrastinating, so that's also part of it.

voices.title: More About Keqing: III
voices.text: Never mince your words with me, okay? Yuheng's just a title. I'll not have you treading on eggshells around me just because of my status. Say what's on your mind, always — that's what makes you unique, and it's the thing I admire about you the most.

voices.title: More About Keqing: IV
voices.text: We've been on our fair share of adventures together, haven't we? The more time we spend together, the more I think that you're the person of my dreams, and— Huh? Why so shocked? You're a crucial part of my dreams for the new Liyue.

voices.title: More About Keqing: V
voices.text: "The time has come for humanity to make its mark in the land of the Geo Archon"... Turns out that was quite an ambitious statement after all. But I want you to make me a promise: come and visit when the new Liyue Harbor is born. I will show you around. After all the help and support you've given me along the way, you deserve to see Liyue reborn with your own eyes. I owe you that much.

voices.title: Keqing's Hobbies
voices.text: That indulgent feeling of being spoilt for choice between countless different varieties... That, to me, is the appeal of shopping.

voices.title: Keqing's Troubles
voices.text: It's great that the quality of life in Liyue is improving for everyone. But one downside is the growing number of people who are happy to reap the rewards without doing their fair share of the work. The Liyue Qixing did not put in all this effort to create a more prosperous society just so people like them can loaf around.

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: It makes no logical sense to be greedy with food, but for me, all rationality goes out the window when there's Golden Shrimp Balls involved... They're just irresistible. The taste of a single Golden Shrimp Ball brings me so much joy that all the stress of work just melts away.

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: Everything has a certain way it should taste. I won't touch anything that tries to break the mold, so no salted Almond Tofu for me, and no sweetened Lotus Seed and Bird Egg Soup either. It's just a total waste of perfectly good ingredients.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: Yep, that's right. My favorite.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: The taste is fairly standard, but I can see you worked hard at it.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: It seems quite a ways off from how it's supposed to taste...

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday! I've got a very special gift for you. It might look like an ordinary old lantern, but this one runs on Electro energy and stays alight for a really long time. For those times when you need a little extra light in your life.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: When your heart is set on something, you get closer to your goal with each passing day.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: Great, having another trick up my sleeve gives me more flexibility in rapidly changing circumstances.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: Yesterday's experiences make me stronger today. And most of those experiences are ones that I share with you.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: I feel I have grown immensely from my travels with you. If, one day, I finally manage to make my dreams a reality... I wonder, will you still be there by my side?

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Incoming!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Speed of light!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Don't blink.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: IV
voices.text: Hah—!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: V
voices.text: Hey!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: VI
voices.text: Huh!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Nowhere to hide!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: With sword comes shadow!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: Cut to the chase!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: You give, you receive.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: Not bad, as far as treasure is concerned...

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: That's everything, on to the next.

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: One step back, two forward...

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: Stronger than I thought.

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: Change of plan.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Take five, I'll take over.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Watch yourself!

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: Right idea, wrong time...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: I will not go quietly...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: What a let-down...

voices.title: Light Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Ugh.

voices.title: Light Hit Taken: II
voices.text: I'll be fine.

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Got lucky that time!

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: Let's go, time is against us.

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: Something's come up?

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: Let's finish this quickly.
